string.name: STR_CASH_PACK_WE_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable eternal (or lesser) weapons up to level 60 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click (or right-click) on the packaging scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_CASH_PACK_AR_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable eternal (or lesser) armour up to level 60 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click (or right-click) on the packaging scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_CASH_PACK_AC_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable eternal (or lesser) accessories and headwear up to level 60 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click on the scroll, then select the item to package.

string.body: This egg hatches the Devil of Glory. \nThis pet collects items during battle, can feed itself and uses magical items.\nVisit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_STUN_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that stuns a target for 1 second with 7%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_BLIND_U1_65A_DESC

string.body: Increases three Physical Attack attributes.\nThere is also a slight chance that attributes of a different category will be increased. Double-click to use it on a weapon.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_AP_U_35P_50Lv_AC_DESC
string.body: If you use it to dismantle your Abyss accessories, you will get back 35%% of the purchase price as Abyss Points.\nFirst, double-click on this tool, then select an item to dismantle.\nCan be used on fabled items up to level 50.

string.body: If you use it to dismantle your Abyss accessories, you will get back 35%% of the purchase price as Abyss Points.\nFirst, double-click on this tool, then select an item to dismantle.\nCan be used on eternal items up to level 60.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WDAY_FLOWER_BOUQUET_DESC
string.body:
The energy of the Bouquet of Flowers increases [%e1.StatUp.Value] by [%e1.StatUp.StatName] points and [%e1.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e1.StatUp.Value2] points for 30 minutes.
Your DP will continually recover for 30 minutes.
This skill can only be used on selected targets, including yourself.
The effect ends when you log out.

string.body: No Soul Sickness and you keep all your XP if you die. Flight or teleport costs just 1 Kinah.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_XP_BOOST_50_DESC
string.body: You receive 50%% additional XP while hunting, gathering and crafting for as long as Snorinerk's Amulet is active.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_GATHER_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: You receive 200%% more skill points for gathering and essencetapping while the effect lasts. \nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the cooldown is 30 minutes. \nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_AP_BOOST_30_DESC
string.body: As long as the effect holds, you receive 30%% additional Abyss points. This, however, does not apply for achievements on the Dredgion and in the Crucible Challenge Training Camp.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_CRAFT_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: You receive 200%% more skill points for magical crafting while this effect lasts. \nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the cooldown is 30 minutes. \nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_DROP_BOOST_20_DESC
string.body: The chance of capturing items from creatures when hunting is increased by 20%% while this effect lasts.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SLOW_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's attack speed by 50%% for 10 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SNARE_U1_65A_DESC

There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_STUN_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that stuns a target for 1 second with 7%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_PARALYZE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that paralyses a target for 4 seconds with 3%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_ROOT_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that immobilises a target for 10 seconds with 3%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SILENCE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that silences a target for 7 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_BLIND_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that blinds a target for 8 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SLOW_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's attack speed by 50%% for 10 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SNARE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's movement speed by 50%% for 10 seconds with 6%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_POISON_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that deals 52 poison damage to a target every 2 seconds for 20 seconds with 11%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_BLEED_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that deals 95 bleeding damage to a target every 2 seconds for 10 seconds with 9%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_FIRE_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that deals 552 fire damage to a target with 11%% probability. There's a certain probability that the stone will be destroyed when socketed or activated.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_EARTH_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_ACCURACY_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases accuracy by 35 points when fixed into an item's Manastone socket.\nActivate the Manastone by clicking on it and then selecting [Use], or by double-clicking (right-clicking). Then select the item for socketing.\nNot for High Daeva items.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_DODGE_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases evasion by 24 points when fixed into an item's Manastone socket.\nActivate the Manastone by clicking on it and then selecting [Use], or by double-clicking (right-clicking). Then select the item for socketing.\nNot for High Daeva items.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_PCRITICAL_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases crit strike by 24 points when fixed into an item's Manastone socket.\nActivate the Manastone by clicking on it and then selecting [Use], or by double-clicking (right-clicking). Then select the item for socketing.\nNot for High Daeva items.

string.name: STR_WRAP_INTERACTIVE_NORMAL_01_DESC
string.body: The Chaos Rift Loot.\nContains Manastones and various rewards.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_INTERACTIVE_SUPER_01_DESC
string.body: The Chaos Rift Victory Bounty.\nContains Petra Medals and various rewards.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_UE_01
string.body: Honourable Ancient Manastone Bundle of the Alabaster Order

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_D_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_UE_01
string.body: Bundle of the Field Wardens' Ancient Manastones

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_OPTION_L_60_01_DESC
string.body: Contains various Alabaster Order's regenerating Manastones.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_UE_01_DESC
string.body: Contains various ancient manastones of the Alabaster Order.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MEDAL_01_DESC
string.body: Contains Petra Medals from headquarters.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_PROC_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle of Fortuneer's Illusion Godstones.\nIt contains various Illusion Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_DAILY_MATTER_ENCHANT_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle that contains Fortuneer Special Magic Powder.\nYou receive magic power or – with a little luck – an All-Powerful Enchantment Stone.\nDouble-click to open.

string.body: A bundle of Illusion Godstones from Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nIt contains various Illusion Godstones. Double-click to open.

string.body: A bundle of Special Magic Powder from Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nIt contains Magic Powder. With a little luck, you will also receive an All-Powerful Enchantment Stone.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_WE_M_50A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable mythical (or lesser) weapons up to level 50 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click (or right-click) on the packaging scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_AR_M_50A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable mythical (or lesser) armour up to level 50 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click (or right-click) on the packaging scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_AC_M_50A_DESC
string.body: Can be used on packable mythical (or lesser) accessories and headwear up to level 50 so that they can be traded afterwards.\nThe packaged item can only be traded once.\nDouble-click on the scroll, then select the item to package.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PETCARD_BUFF_SHEEPBLUE_01_DESC
string.body:
An egg of an Azure Ayas.
It gives you a Spiciness Bundle when you feed it. The Pet cooks and uses magical items automatically for you and loots defeated adversaries.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
You can keep this companion for 7 days.

An egg of a Bow Ayas.
The Pet loots defeated enemies.
It also gives you a Spiciness Bundle when you feed it.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
You can keep this companion for 7 days.

You can keep this companion for 7 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_SCROLL_START_KIT_01_DESC
string.body: While the effect lasts, you avoid Soul Sickness and keep all your XP if you die. Flight or teleport costs just 1 Kinah.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_XP_BOOST_50_DESC
string.body: While this effect lasts, you receive 50%% more Skill Points for the skills Gathering, Crafting and Hunting Creatures.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes. The recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_GATHER_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: You receive 200%% more skill points for gathering and essencetapping while the effect lasts. \nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the cooldown is 30 minutes. \nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_AP_BOOST_30_DESC
string.body: You receive 30%% additional Abyss Points while the effect holds. However, this does not apply for achievements on the Dredgion and in the Crucible Training Camp.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_CRAFT_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: You receive 200%% more skill points for magical crafting while this effect lasts. \nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes and the cooldown is 30 minutes. \nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_DROP_BOOST_20_DESC
string.body: The chance of obtaining items from creatures when Hunting is increased by 20%% while this effect lasts.\nThe effect lasts for 30 minutes. The recovery time is 30 minutes.\nThe effect applies to all group members.

string.name: STR_CASH_FOOD_BLACKDRAGON_DESC
string.body: You turn into a Wyvern who can use special skill sets for 60 minutes. Increases [%e2.StatUp.StatName] by [%e2.StatUp.Value] points, [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e2.StatUp.Value2] points, [%e3.StatUp.StatName] by [%e3.StatUp.Value]%% points and [%e3.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e3.StatUp.Value2]%% points.

string.name: STR_CASH_FOOD_PANDA_DESC

string.body:
A Rampant Shughost Egg.
This Pet automatically uses your cooking and magical items.
The attack values of his owner increase if he is fed Aether Cherries.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
The Pet will be your companion for 30 days.

The defence values of his owner increase if he is fed Aether Cherries.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
The Pet will be your companion for 30 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_BUFF_U_DOGKNIGHT_01_DESC
string.body:
An egg containing Puppy Knight Tom.
Automatically uses your cooking and magic items.
If you feed it, it will give you a bundle of items that increase the XP you can obtain.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.

string.name: STR_CASH_PETCARD_BUFF_U_DOGKNIGHT_01_7DAY_DESC
string.body:
A Puppy Knight Tom's egg.
This pet automatically uses your cooking and magic items.
When you feed him he will give you a bundle of items which increase XP.
Follows you for 7 days.

string.body: Adds a weapon effect that stuns a target for 1 second with 8%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_OPENAERIAL_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that holds a target with Aether's Hold for 3 seconds with 5%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SPIN_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that spins target for 2 seconds with 5%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_STAGGER_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that throws a target back for 2 seconds with 5%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_STUMBLE_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that makes a target stumble for 5 seconds with 3%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_FEAR_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that strikes fear into a target for 3 seconds with 5%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_SLEEP_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that puts a target to sleep for 2 seconds with 7%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_BIND_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that binds a target for 6 seconds with 7%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_DEFEND_DEBUFF_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that reduces the target's physical damage reduction and magic suppression by 35%% for 10 seconds with 7%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used up.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_PVE_DAMAGE_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Adds a weapon effect that deals 9,000 magical damage to a monster with 4%% probability. Is destroyed when all the buff effects are used.\nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_IDETERNITY_WAR_KISK_LIGHT_PRATY_01_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It can only be activated in the Neviwind Canyon by up to 6 people.\nCan only be used by members in the same group as the summoner.

string.name: STR_IDETERNITY_WAR_KISK_DARK_PRATY_01_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It can only be activated in the Neviwind Canyon by up to 6 people.\nCan only be used by members in the same group as the summoner.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDETERNITY_WAR_SCROLL_01_DESC
string.body: Contains many scrolls that are useful in battle.\nDisappears when you leave the Neviwind Canyon.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDETERNITY_WAR_SCROLL_02_DESC
string.body: Contains a Stun Scroll or Scroll of Paralysis for the Neviwind Canyon.\nDisappears when you leave the Neviwind Canyon.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDETERNITY_WAR_SCROLL_03_DESC
string.body: Contains a Scroll of Blinding or a Scroll of Silence and Blinding for the Neviwind Canyon.\nDisappears when you leave the Neviwind Canyon.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDETERNITY_WAR_SCROLL_04_DESC
string.body: Contains a Protective Shield Scroll or an Invincibility Scroll for the Neviwind Canyon.\nDisappears when you leave the Neviwind Canyon.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_EVENT2017_PETCARD_BUFF_SHEEPBLUE_01_DESC
string.body:
An egg of an Azure Ayas.
The pet uses cooking and magical items for you automatically.
It gives you a Spiciness Bundle when you feed it.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
You can keep this companion for 7 days.

string.name: STR_EVENT2017_PETCARD_LOOT_SHEEPCHOCO_01_DESC
string.body:
An egg of a Bow Ayas.
The pet loots defeated enemies.
It also gives you a Spiciness Bundle when you feed it.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
You can keep this companion for 7 days.

string.name: STR_EVENT2017_PETCARD_ALER_SHEEPNEWYEAR_01_DESC
string.body:
An egg of a Hat Ayas.
Warns you of approaching enemies.
It gives you a Spiciness Bundle when you feed it.
Visit a Pet Minder to hatch this egg.
You can keep this companion for 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_LIGHT_TITLE01_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Asmodian Deathbringer> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic defence in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 2%%, and movement speed by 2%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_LIGHT_TITLE02_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Corpserunner> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic attack in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 1%%, and movement speed by 4%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_LIGHT_TITLE03_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Whitewing Angel of Death> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic attack in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 2%%, and movement speed by 2%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_DARK_TITLE01_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Elyos Deathbringer> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic defence in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 2%%, and movement speed by 2%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_DARK_TITLE02_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Corpsetreader> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic attack in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 1%%, and movement speed by 4%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_QUEST_SP_PVP_DARK_TITLE03_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Blackwing Angel of Death> title.\nIncreases your physical and magic attack in PvP by 1%%, attack speed and casting speed by 2%%, and movement speed by 2%%.

string.name: STR_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
Can enchant certain Stigmas.
If the enchantment is successful, the level is increased by 1. There is a slight possibility that the level may also increase by 2 or 3.
If the attempt fails, the level is reduced by 1. There is a slight possibility that the previous level will remain unchanged.
Activate the Stigma Enchantment Stone by double-clicking it, and select a Stigma to enchant.

string.body: A crystal from which a faint sense of Aion's power emanates.\nBring it to the merchant for Genesis Crystals in the Everlasting Life Refuge or in the Temple of Perpetual Wisdom in Lakrum, where you can exchange it for precious items.
